website.note: No therapeutic drug pipeline page; QIAGEN is a molecular diagnostics / sample-and-assay company. They develop companion diagnostics (e.g., therascreen KRAS) and digital insights tools, not internally-sponsored therapeutic drugs.

ctgov.note: Sole hit is a Neuron23 trial (NEU-411) using QIAGEN diagnostic; not a QIAGEN-owned therapeutic asset.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: QIAGEN is a diagnostics and life-science tools company. It does not develop or sponsor proprietary Phase 1/2/3 therapeutic drugs. Its clinical-trial involvement is limited to companion-diagnostic (CDx) partnerships with pharma sponsors.

commercial_product.note: Diagnostics, sample technologies, and bioinformatics products (QIAstat-Dx, QuantiFERON, therascreen CDx, QIAGEN Digital Insights, etc.) — not therapeutic drugs.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Partner trial; QIAGEN supplies CDx, not the therapeutic
